senses.gloss:
n. (-लं)
1 Wickedness.
2 Fraud, circumvention, trick, stratagem.
3 Design, device.
E.
छो to cut, कलच् affix, and the radical final rejected.

nf. (-नं-ना)
Tricking, deceiving.
E.
छल nominal verb, युच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Cunning, crafty, deceitful.
E.
छलना, and पर addicted to.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Deceiving, cheating.
E.
छल nom. verb to cheat, शतृ aff.

m. (-ली)
A cheat.
E.
छल, and इनि aff.

f. (-ल्लिः)
Skin, bark, rind, &c.
E.
छद a cover, ला to give or get; with affix कि, द becomes ल; also with ङीप् added छल्ली.

f. (-ल्ली)
1 Skin, bark, rind, &c.
2 Offspring, posterity.
3 A spreading creeper.
4 A kind of flower.
E.
see the preceding.
